# FQHESphereLPlus

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereLPlus`

```text
FQHESphereLPlus, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereLPlus [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -z, --lz : twice the total lz value of the system for the initial state (default value = 0)
    -s, --statistics : particle statistics (boson or fermion, try to guess it from file name if not defined)
    --nbr-lp : number of time the L^+ operator has to be applied (default value = 1)
    --input-reference : use a haldane basis with the given reference file for the input file
    --output-reference : use a haldane basis with the given reference file for the output file
    --save-all : save all states when applying L^+ multiple times
    --check-l2 : check the L^2 value after applying L^+

data options:
    -i, --input-file : input vector file name
    -o, --output-file : output vector file name
    --interaction-name : interaction name for the output files when computing more than one state

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
